apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- feat(ui): rename the Discover navigation label to Search (`cf0c509b`)
- feat(ui): use Phosphor corners and queue icons with matching names (`9d253424`)
- feat(desktop): pin the fullscreen button below the update banner and move banner actions to the edge (`b7302bdd`)
- fix(updates): keep the update banner and top inset steady across core snapshots (`c073c40a`)
- perf(artwork): size the decoded cache from total RAM and drop extra pixel copies (`52c91315`)
- perf(desktop): cap malloc arenas and map the emoji font instead of copying it (`29f3a696`)
- feat(settings): hero badges toggle with a single chosen source (`abc0cad2`)
- feat(ui): switch every shared icon to Phosphor (`2255cbeb`)
- feat(ui): navigation label modes, Phosphor icons and a pill bottom bar on mobile (`8d08170b`)
- fix(renderer): mipmap profile artwork so avatars stay sharp when downscaled (`f78d604d`)
- fix(ui): keep the compact preview and trailer skip to Continue Watching and close the seam under preview art (`8ad50e88`)
- feat(desktop): smooth mouse wheel scrolling like Chromium (`70c9df1e`)
- fix(host): keep the cached page under the sources modal from blinking (`e014478f`)
- fix(ui): drop back arrow on the sources modal, ease the hero fade and cull offscreen rows (`a84b1cbe`)
- perf(host): reuse the page under the sources modal between frames (`17003be3`)
- perf(player): cache converted stream rows between frames (`dcdd8c6f`)
- fix(plugins): split episode ids from the right (`88b57c51`
